transcript.title: Weekly round-up
transcript.text: Hello, I'm Nova, the Ventryx AI presenter. This is your weekly market round-up for the week ending Friday 23 October.

transcript.title: Markets this week
transcript.text: Here's how the markets closed the week. The S&P 500 finished down 0.5 per cent. The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 was down 0.8 per cent, and here in London the FTSE 100 ended down 1.8 per cent. Bitcoin was down 2.1 per cent over seven days.

transcript.title: Biggest movers
transcript.text: Among the hundred big US stocks we track, the top riser was CrowdStrike, up 13.3 per cent, followed by ServiceNow and Palo Alto Networks. At the other end, Lam Research fell 12.8 per cent, with KLA and AT&T also lower.

transcript.title: In the headlines
transcript.text: In the news on CrowdStrike, Yahoo Finance ran the headline: CrowdStrike’s CEO Says a Wave of Cyber Attacks Are Coming.

transcript.title: In the headlines
transcript.text: In the news on Lam Research, Yahoo Finance ran the headline: Lam Research (LRCX) Stock Faces Q1 Earnings Quality Questions After Records.

transcript.title: Momentum top 5
transcript.text: On the Ventryx momentum list, this month's five are Micron Technology, Dell, Advanced Micro Devices, Intel and Marvell Technology. All five are holding their places for now. The next swap is on Friday 30 October.

transcript.title: Crypto top 5
transcript.text: In crypto, our experimental top five are Zcash, Uniswap, NEAR Protocol, Arbitrum and Chainlink, with Bitcoin 10 per cent above its two-hundred-day average.

transcript.title: Next week
transcript.text: Looking ahead to the week of Monday 26 October. Results are due from Visa and Coca-Cola Company (The) on Tuesday; Alphabet and Microsoft on Wednesday; Amazon.com and Eli Lilly and on Thursday. And on the prediction market Polymarket, the question "Will Bitcoin dip to $77,500 in October?" is trading at about 42 per cent yes.

transcript.title: That's the week
transcript.text: That's your round-up. Remember, this is research, not financial advice. I'm Nova. See you next Sunday.
